agentChatEnabled.title: Talk to your deployed applications (preview)
agentChatEnabled.description: Lists your deployed applications in the AI Agents panel and lets you talk to their agents. Those kept always on can be talked to; the others are listed as closed, saying why. Off by default; the runtimes' chat is the same either way.

acpAgentEnabled.title: Agent over ACP (preview)
acpAgentEnabled.description: Adds an 'Agent over ACP' mode beside a runtime's chat: a shielded harness on the runtime, reached over the Agent Client Protocol, editing the runtime's workspace; its diffs and the questions the Shield lets through are shown in the panel. Off by default.
